name: DARBS AI
desc: Diagnostic Assistant for Repair, Bugs, and Support. AI-powered troubleshooting assistant designed to help users identify and solve common laptop and computer problems such as slow performance, system errors, software issues, and other technical problems.

name: Student Grading System
desc: A college-branded grade-entry window with a list of subjects and course codes, editable grade fields, a GWA control, and creator credit.

name: DARBS Mall Admin Login
desc: A centered login screen with the DARBS Mall logo, username and password fields, a “Show Password” checkbox, and Login, Sign Up, and Exit buttons.

name: Space War Shooter
desc: A retro space-themed start screen with a starry background, planet and space imagery, a bold “SPACE WAR SHOOTER” title, and Start Game and Exit buttons.

name: Student Information Form
desc: A student-record window with full-name and ID-number fields, a table or list of subjects and grades, and a Save button. Connect it to a MySQL database for storing student records.

name: Water Billing System
desc: A customer-account interface for managing meter readings, billing periods, water usage, charges, payments, and outstanding balances. Include actions to find a customer, record a reading, generate a bill, and record a payment.

name: Event Tracker
desc: An event-management interface with fields for event name, date and time, venue, organizer, status, and notes. Include a searchable event list and actions to add, edit, and mark events complete.

name: Portfolio-Sui with DEVCON
desc: A personal portfolio created through the DEVCON Sui Move Code Camp, showcasing my IT skills, projects, and experience.
